objective: First-principles fast-kill of a K3/S2 source-order three-output-row LB-FUSE decoder on the complete independently admitted M705/M699 H67 ep35 S3x10 payload. Compare against a fair A1-OSG with the same 96 lanes, 240-KiB budget, dense commit, source-order row lifetime and on-chip psum port. Ordinary on-chip psum RMW is not DRAM. If A1 avoids off-chip psum spill, the traffic path is killed.

resource_coordinate.onchip_psum_port: one serialized 1RW port, identical for A1-OSG and LB-FUSE
resource_coordinate.dense_commit: 41 cycles and 384 padded bytes per 96-channel output vector, identical
resource_coordinate.d3_baseline_no_spill: Acc24 output-width stripe, maximum aligned width 256; two stripes overlap by one input column
d3_candidates: full-width Acc16 after order-independent trace bound

cycle_model.nature: deterministic executable model, not RTL or a cycle-accurate full-decoder simulator
cycle_model.a1_osg: source scan plus contributor materialization/bundle, destination-packed K8 groups at 15 cycles/group, finite weight refill, common dense commit and terminal/directory cycles
cycle_model.fair_no_spill: A1 receives the same three-output-row lifetime. D0-D2 retain full-width Acc24; D3 uses legal 256+64 output-width stripes. All ordinary psum RMW bytes remain on-chip and use the same 1RW port.
cycle_model.lb_direct: source-order groups are formed independently per source position and 16-channel tile, multiplied by exact legal tap fanout. They cannot combine the up-to-four spatial contributors that A1-OSG destination packing combines.
cycle_model.group_service: 96-channel group: six 16-lane slices, 12 serialized 1RW operations inside 15 cycles. Cout48 pass: three slices, six operations inside nine cycles.
cycle_model.d3_acc16: same cycles as full-width LB-DIRECT; halves psum word bytes only after the complete-trace absolute-sum bound proves every accumulation order remains within signed Acc16
cycle_model.d3_cout48: two source passes, two direct bundle issues, two nine-cycle group services, two half-tile refill latencies, and common packed dense commit

numeric_exactness.a1_reference: CPU torch conv_transpose2d over local per-output-channel symmetric INT8 weights
numeric_exactness.lb_reference: independent nine-tap source-order matrix products placed into exact K3/S2/P1/OP1 output coordinates
numeric_exactness.float32_exactness: formal four-tap Cin*127 absolute bound must remain below 2^24 and signed Acc24
numeric_exactness.acc16_test: CPU convolution with absolute INT8 weights gives an order-independent upper bound on every partial-prefix magnitude for every output; <=32767 is required
numeric_exactness.local_int8_scope: scheduling and bit-width probe only; not checkpoint numeric or accuracy admission

prior: Chang and Chang transposed-convolution decomposition, arXiv:2205.02103
standard stride-2 polyphase decomposition and existing M514/M523 mapping/bundling
prior_and_claim.object_delta_only: H67 binary ATLIF descriptors, parity-asymmetric 1/2/2/4 tap sets, signed Acc24/local INT8, 240-KiB capacity and 96-wide issue

decision_gate.performance_go: headline ratio-of-sums A1/LB >=1.20 and every sequence >=1.05
decision_gate.traffic_go: A1/LB >=1/1.05 and off-chip psum backing bytes reduce >=30 percent
decision_gate.fair_a1_zero_spill: immediate KILL of the traffic path
